title: A fixed-scalar complex in constant-ring coordinates
statement: Let X be a scheme and k a commutative ring in universe u+1, where X is in universe u. For a cochain complex T of fixed-k module sheaves on the small pro-etale site of X, define its coefficient-sized constant-ring model by precomposing each term with AsSmall.down [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], then applying the inverse of the specified exact constant-scalar restriction equivalence [def-coef-constant-scalar-restriction, lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor], and finally localizing the resulting cochain complex. No new scalar action or derived functor is chosen by a mere existence assertion.
